title: Amazon’s Bee launches two new personal AI devices, starting at $75
snippet: Amazon-owned Bee has launched its first new AI devices since its acquisition, including an updated wearable and a credit-card-sized recorder that attaches to smartphones. The devices can summarize conversations, create to-do lists, and integrate with Alexa and Amazon shopping, with prices starting at $74.99.

title: Citizen Lab says governments are abusing online ads to hack people with ‘zero-click’ spyware
